The Energy Cost Problem

With rising energy prices across Europe, domestic and commercial heating has become one of the biggest fixed costs. Inefficient systems, uninsulated walls and improper usage habits can triple actual costs compared to what is necessary.

The good news: with the right technology, it is possible to reduce the bill by 30% to 40% without sacrificing comfort, with a return on investment in a few years.

Our Approach

Duotherm

Natural stone radiators with infrared technology. They heat by direct radiation without circulating air healthier and up to 40% more efficient than convection.

ClimateCoating

Ceramic membrane applied to walls and ceilings that retains heat inside and prevents thermal bridges reduces energy losses by up to 30%.

Types of Cost Reduction

Duotherm Replacement

Replacing inefficient boiler or radiators with Duotherm reduces consumption by 30-40%. No construction, direct electrical connection. Safer, healthier and quieter.

Insulation with ClimateCoating

Applying ceramic membrane to walls and ceilings reduces losses by 30%. Improves existing insulation and prevents thermal bridges. ROI in 4-6 years.

Combined Solution

Duotherm + ClimateCoating together maximize efficiency up to 60%. Efficient heating with better insulation. Maximum savings in 3-4 years.

Solutions by Sector

Habitação Unifamiliar

Houses and apartments benefit from immediate reduction with no construction. Duotherm selectively heats rooms, ClimateCoating improves walls. ROI: 3-5 years.

Espaços Comerciais

Shops, offices and restaurants significantly reduce monthly bills. Zone control allows heating only occupied areas. ROI: 2-3 years.

Edifícios Antigos

Historic buildings with poor insulation benefit from Duotherm + ClimateCoating. Without damaging facades, improve efficiency 50%. ROI: 4-6 years.

Indústria Ligeira

Factories and workshops with large heated areas reduce consumption with modular Duotherm. Zone heating optimizes costs. ROI: 2-4 years.

4 Ways to Save More

Zone heating

Heat only rooms in use. Duotherm radiators allow independent control per room.

Lower comfort temperature

The warmth of infrared feels the same as air heated 2-3°C higher which means less consumption.

Wall insulation

ClimateCoating retains up to 30% of the heat normally lost through walls and ceilings.

Smart scheduling

Several Duotherm models include a thermostat and timer, avoiding unnecessary spending.

FAQ

How much can I save on my energy bill?

Our clients record savings of 30 to 40% in heating costs, depending on existing insulation and usage habits.

How long until I recover my investment?

Typically 3 to 5 years, based on monthly energy savings. After that period, all savings are pure gain.

Does Duotherm work in all rooms?

Yes. There is a wide range of models in different sizes and natural stone finishes, suitable for any room and decorative style.

Does ClimateCoating replace traditional insulation?

It complements existing insulation. The ceramic membrane reduces thermal losses in walls and ceilings, working alongside other systems.

Do I need construction work to install Duotherm?

No. Duotherm radiators are plug-and-play they connect to a regular electrical socket, with no pipe installation or construction needed.

What is the difference between Duotherm and traditional boiler?

Duotherm heats by radiation without losing energy through piping and water circulation. This results in 40% more efficiency and less waste. Traditional boilers heat air which disperses easily.

Is infrared heating safe for children and pets?

Completely safe. Duotherm radiators do not emit harmful ultraviolet radiation, only infrared that mimics heat from the sun. There is no risk of burns from brief contact.

Can I use Duotherm only in winter?

Yes. Since they require no maintenance and are plug-and-play, you can store them in summer and install only when needed. This makes the solution even more economically efficient.
